name: Local SEO Lesson - Module 1 Local SEO Fundamentals
body:
> Lesson · 2026-10-08

# Summary
Foundation lesson: what local SEO is, how local results are laid out and which factors drive them.

# Key concepts
- Local SEO targets map pack and local organic results for people searching "right now" (about 56% of on-the-go mobile searches have local intent, per the lesson).
- The local 3-pack sits above organic results.
- Google's three local ranking pillars: **proximity**, **relevance**, **prominence**.
- Local SEO often beats traditional advertising on ROI because the searcher is ready to buy (for example "emergency plumber [city]").
- SEO is long term; results come from doing every step consistently.

# Implementation steps
1. Baseline search for the business name and "[service] in [city]"; note map pack and organic presence.
2. Make sure a Google account exists for GBP, GA4 and GSC.
3. Gather the master business info: exact name, address, phone, URL, hours, short description.

# How this applies to TAG clients
- TAG baselines live in the [SEO Tracker](lib:brain-seo-tracker) and [Documentation Screenshots](lib:brain-documentation-screenshots) (baseline stage).
- Master NAP data per client lives in each company profile (for example [Pipeliners - Company Profile](lib:brain-pipeliners-company-profile)).
